findings.title: Core propagation incorrectly expects a shutdown wrapper
findings.detail: Lifecycle.shutdown_result/2 collapses any participant pending_result into that same terminal result. The probe must compare exact cached expected_stop, not invent an aggregate shutdown wrapper.
